title: [curl] save and restore explicit `SameSite` cookie attributes
body:
#### 1ef2cad825b2e83009ed474fe7d00a4e60f4659a 
[curl] save and restore explicit `SameSite` cookie attributes
<https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=332183>

Reviewed by NOBODY (OOPS!).

The CURL cookie jar ignores explicit `SameSite` policies, so `Lax` and `Strict` cookies can be sent with requests from another site.

Tests: http/tests/websocket/tests/hybi/websocket-samesite-lax-not-sent-cross-site.html
       http/tests/websocket/tests/hybi/websocket-samesite-strict-not-sent-cross-site.html

* Source/WebCore/platform/network/curl/CookieJarDB.h:
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::DatabaseError): Added.
* Source/WebCore/platform/network/curl/CookieJarDB.cpp:
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::openDatabase):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::tryOpenDatabase): Added.
(WebCore::primarySQLiteResultCode): Added.
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::errorForSQLiteResult): Added.
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::errorForSchemaResult): Added.
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::verifySchemaVersion):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::deleteAllTables): Deleted.
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::checkSQLiteReturnCode):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::checkDatabaseValidity):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::deleteAllDatabaseFiles):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::searchCookies):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::getAllCookies):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::setCookie):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::deleteCookiesForHostname):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::deleteAllCookies):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::createPrepareStatement):
(WebCore::CookieJarDB::executeSQLStatement):
Store and restore `Cookie::sameSite` and use `SameSiteInfo` when selecting cookies.
For requests from another site, exclude `Strict` cookies and allow `Lax` cookies only on safe top level navigations.
Keep the migration transactional and step the schema version query before reading its result.
Group migrations by schema version and normalize extended SQLite result codes in one helper.
Preserve cookies on locking or storage errors, and only recreate the database once for corruption or an unusable schema.
Classify SQLite errors before cleanup and validate the schema and prepared statements before exposing the database to cookie operations.

* Source/WebCore/platform/network/curl/CookieUtil.cpp:
(WebCore::CookieUtil::parseCookieAttributes):
(WebCore::CookieUtil::parseCookieHeader):
Parse the `SameSite` attribute case insensitively.
Only parse attributes after the cookie name and value so a cookie named `SameSite` is not treated as an attribute.

* Source/WebKit/NetworkProcess/curl/NetworkStorageSessionCurl.cpp:
(WebKit::cookiesForSession):
(WebKit::NetworkStorageSession::cookiesForDOM const):
(WebKit::NetworkStorageSession::getRawCookies const):
(WebKit::NetworkStorageSession::cookieRequestHeaderFieldValue const):
Pass the request context through the cookie lookups using `SameSiteInfo`.

* LayoutTests/platform/win/TestExpectations:
Remove the expected failures for the existing `SameSite` WebSocket tests.
